boundary_and_prelude: The frozen observer finish_instruction observes every committed instruction fetch, including prelude instructions. Scope opening snapshots time/features; it does not reset cache or engine state.

The source calls prepare and measure before execute has ever run. The measure prologue resets all output sentinels and guards before opening the window. Ordinary fences are present; no fence.i flush is requested.
ELF measure begins at0x80000670, capacity_begin at0x800006ce, execute at0x800006f6, capacity_end at0x800006dc. The opening CSR and execute entry share already-fetched64-byte line0x800006c0.

The measured execute path newly touches64-byte lines0x80000700,0x80000740,0x80000780. The first is crossed by the4-byte instruction at0x800006fe; the next two contain compute/output-submission instructions. These lines were not architecturally executed by the prepare/reset prelude.

Before EACH warm measurement the exact execute path runs untimed, with complete output checking. Thus warm labels represent controlled executed history; neither label asserts hardware cache contents were flushed or directly measured.

comparison_with_prior_family.interpretation: Those earlier same-instruction-count first-use premiums agreed in direction and approximate magnitude, whereas the new q1 premium does not. This rules out using one universal first-use correction based on these families. Original seven-arm spread failures and new paired/state failures all remain recorded.

established_and_unknown.established: No evidence of a scope-entry reset or an omitted architecturally executed warmup. Model premium is isolated to instruction fetch accounting.
unknown: Physical instruction-cache refill events and their ready times were not captured.
Retained cycle totals cannot distinguish speculative/prefetched line presence, different refill service, frontend overlap, or cache/accelerator critical-path overlap.
Three observed model misses do not prove three corresponding physical misses.
Issued depth11 command counts exceed named queue capacities, but these receipts do not independently prove peak simultaneous occupancy or saturation.
